category: tunnel software with a managed http tier

free_tier.stated: The managed version of Tunnelite supports HTTP(S), WebSocket (WS/WSS) and Server-Sent Events tunneling. If you need TCP tunneling, you'll have to host the server yourself.

egress.terms: No allowance is published for the managed tier.; ingress: http-only

chaining: Needs a VM for anything beyond HTTP.
binding_note: The managed tier carries HTTP and WebSocket only, so the protocol fails before any byte quota.

identity_cost.detail: an account on the managed service; self-hosting needs no account.

confidence_note: A UDP listener in the managed service would change the verdict; none is described.

evidence.proved: managed tier is HTTP(S), WS/WSS and SSE; 'If you need TCP tunneling, you'll have to host the server yourself.'

notes: Recorded to separate the managed product from the self-hostable server, since the aggregator lists it as TCP/HTTP/WS.

extras.volume_stated: No allowance is published for the managed tier.
